title: DeveloperOS legacy alert rule inventory (routes/alerts.js) — recorded before DI-1 implementation

inputs.partners: partnersRepo.getAll() — NOT tenant scoped: every organization's partners are loaded
inputs.capitalStacks: capitalRepo.getAll() — called WITHOUT organizationId; the repository filters projects.organization_id = $1 with $1 = NULL and therefore returns no rows

engine.clock: Every alert stamps createdAt = new Date(); R5 computes days remaining from new Date()
engine.persistence: none — alerts are recomputed per request and never stored

rules.currentBehavior: For every task with status != 'complete' and no contractId, emit one alert (id alert-nocontract-<taskId>). Description renders the task's partner name via partnerName(partnerId).
rules.tenantScoping: Tasks scoped. Partner names are looked up in the unscoped partner list, so a task that references a foreign organization's partner renders that partner's name.
knownDefects: DI1-DEFECT-PARTNER: foreign partner name disclosed through partnerName() when a task references another organization's partner (POST/PUT /api/tasks and POST /api/contracts accept a foreign partnerId; partners.id has no same-tenant constraint)

DI1-DEFECT-REF-STATUS: a foreign contractId IS rejected by the existing database constraint tasks_contract_project_fkey (tenant integrity holds), but the API surfaces it as HTTP 500 instead of the 404 concealment response. Corrected after the first RED run: the pre-run inventory wrongly stated that the API accepts it.
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per incomplete task without a contract; sources [task]

rules.currentBehavior: For every contract with status 'missing' and linkedTaskCount > 0, emit one alert (id alert-contract-<contractId>), titled with the partner name.
rules.tenantScoping: Contracts scoped; partner name lookup unscoped (same partner defect as R1).
knownDefects: DI1-DEFECT-PARTNER (title renders partner name from the unscoped partner list)
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per missing contract with linked tasks; sources [contract]

rules.currentBehavior: Collect ALL blocked tasks across ALL projects and emit ONE alert whose id and projectId are those of the first blocked task's project; the description lists every blocked task title.
knownDefects: DI1-DEFECT-R3-CONFLATION: blocked tasks of several projects are reported as one alert attributed to the first project — not traceable to the correct records
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per project that has blocked tasks; sources [project, ...its blocked tasks]

rules.currentBehavior: For every permit with status 'corrections', emit one alert (id alert-permit-<permitId>) counting corrections whose status != 'complete'.
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per permit in corrections; sources [permit, ...open corrections]

rules.currentBehavior: For every capital source with status 'pending' and a deadline, daysLeft = round((deadline - now)/1 day); emit when daysLeft < 60; critical when < 30 else warning (id alert-capital-<sourceId>).
rules.tenantScoping: BROKEN: capitalRepo.getAll() is called without organizationId and returns no rows for any tenant.
rules.timeDependency: SEMANTIC: reads the system clock (new Date()) to decide whether and how severely to alert
rules.severity: critical (< 30 days, including overdue) / warning (< 60 days)
rules.sourceRecords: none emitted (no capital source or stack id in the alert)
knownDefects: DEVOS-DI1-TENANT-CAPITAL-001: rule never fires — valid tenant capital information is omitted
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per qualifying pending capital source relative to explicit asOf; sources [capital_stack, capital_source]

rules.currentBehavior: For every project with phase >= 3, find the FIRST contract whose type contains 'general contractor' (case-insensitive) and status != 'executed'; emit one alert (id alert-gc-<projectId>).
rules.expectedOutput: One finding per phase>=3 project with an unexecuted GC contract; sources [project, contract]
